narration: The same money, a different life. For {identical_months} months there was only one of you. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. Both of you were laid off in month {layoff_month}, the ghost with {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} less of the ghost's pay was claimed before each month began, its Freedom {freedom_gap}. The ghost ended with {net_worth_gap}.
